english.title: Attempt to Breach SOPO / interim SOPO / foreign travel order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, attempted to do something, namely **(..SPECIFY THING ATTEMPTED TO BE DONE..), which you were prohibited from doing by

(A)_[a sexual offences prevention order made under section 104]_
(B)_[an interim sexual offences prevention order made under section 109]_
(C)_[a foreign travel order made under section 114]_

of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER OR INTERIM ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 103I(1) and (3) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuse
attempted to do anything prohibited by
SOPO / interim SOPO / foreign travel order

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where a person is convicted of an offence under this section, it is not open to the court by or before which the person is convicted to make, in respect of the offence, an order for conditional discharge.
(ii) This offence relates to a breach of a SOPO, interim SOPO or foreign travel order made under sections 103A to 103k of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
(iii) For attempt to Breach SOPO / interim SOPO / foreign travel order prior to the 29th November 2022, see offence H19569.
